panels.art_prompt: Close-up of the cat sitting on the squashed oversized tan woven straw sun hat, eyes half-closed, deeply pleased. Tail draped to one side.

Sam sits cross-legged on the wooden floor next to the mat. The cat is now beside him on the mat (not on the same oversized tan woven straw sun hat with a very wide brim anymore — the same oversized tan woven straw sun hat with a very wide brim is set aside). Both are looking at each other.

Wordless. Wide shot. The cat is curled up asleep on the same oversized tan woven straw sun hat with a very wide brim, on the mat, in a pool of golden late-afternoon sun.
